row.body: The grocery note says every item was collected before the westbound trip; a food tin remains beside the argument about who should be left in charge.
row.title: Food stop on the way out

sidecar.gloss: A departure is recorded as complete while food and an unresolved duty remain.
sidecar.rival_reading: An emergency departure could leave a tin and household disagreement behind; the note does not identify the reason for leaving.
